theme: 教材片語・中高階 750–850 第 17 群

items.colloc: experienced sales person 資深業務員 | contact a sales person 聯繫業務員
items.distinct: sales representative 銷售代表 | clerk 店員（門市）
ex: The sales person provided a detailed product demonstration.
業務員提供了詳細的產品演示。
Please consult a sales person for current discounts.
請詢問銷售人員目前的折扣優惠。
Our top sales person exceeded the annual quota.
我們最優秀的業務員超過了年度配額。

items.colloc: build a scale model 製作比例模型 | show a scale model 展示比例模型
items.distinct: prototype 原型機 | mock-up 實體模型（通常為等比例）
ex: The architect presented a scale model of the building.
建築師展示了該建築的比例模型。
We used a scale model to test the wind resistance.
我們使用比例模型來測試抗風性。
The company displayed a scale model in the lobby.
公司在大廳展示了一個比例模型。

items.pos: adj. 二手的；間接得到的
items.colloc: second hand furniture 二手家具 | second hand information 間接消息
items.distinct: used 使用過的 | recycled 回收再利用的
ex: He bought some second hand office equipment to save money.
他買了一些二手辦公設備以節省開支。
This information is only second hand from my manager.
這項消息只是我從經理那邊聽來的間接資訊。
Many startups prefer purchasing second hand machinery.
許多新創公司傾向購買二手機械設備。

items.colloc: pay a security deposit 支付押金 | refund a security deposit 退還押金
items.distinct: down payment 頭期款 | earnest money 定金
ex: A security deposit is required for the office rental.
承租辦公室需要支付一筆押金。
The landlord returned the security deposit after the inspection.
房東在驗屋後退還了押金。
Please ensure the security deposit is paid before moving.
請確保在搬入前已支付保證金。

items.colloc: take a short cut 走捷徑 | find a short cut 尋找捷徑
items.distinct: alternative route 替代路線 | direct path 直達路徑
ex: There is no short cut to achieving professional success.
在職業生涯取得成功沒有捷徑。
The delivery driver took a short cut through the alley.
快遞司機抄捷徑穿過巷子。
Management wanted a short cut to improve efficiency.
管理層想尋找提升效率的捷徑。

items.colloc: show up late 遲到 | show up on time 準時出現
items.distinct: turn up 到達；出現 | attend 出席
ex: Most employees managed to show up for the meeting.
大部分員工都設法出席了會議。
He did not show up despite the urgent invitation.
儘管有緊急邀約，他仍未出現。
Will the keynote speaker show up before the event?
主講人會在活動前露面嗎？

items.colloc: sign up for a course 報名課程 | sign up online 線上註冊
items.distinct: register 登記 | enroll 入學；註冊
ex: Interested candidates should sign up by Friday afternoon.
有意者應在週五下午前報名。
I decided to sign up for the professional training session.
我決定報名參加這次專業培訓課程。
Please sign up on the website to receive updates.
請在網站上註冊以接收最新消息。

items.pos: n. 微小的機會；可能性
items.colloc: a slight chance of success 成功的微小機會 | only a slight chance 只有一點機會
items.distinct: slim hope 渺茫的希望 | remote possibility 極小的可能性
ex: There is a slight chance that the shipment will arrive early.
貨物提前抵達的可能性很小。
Even a slight chance of growth is worth pursuing.
即使只有微小的成長機會也值得追求。
He realized there was a slight chance of winning the contract.
他意識到贏得合約的機會非常渺茫。

items.pos: phr. 大聲說出來；公開表達意見
items.colloc: speak up clearly 大聲說清楚 | encourage someone to speak up 鼓勵某人發表意見
items.distinct: speak out 公開反對（不公） | raise one's voice 提高音量
ex: Employees are encouraged to speak up during staff meetings.
鼓勵員工在員工會議中公開表達意見。
Could you please speak up so everyone can hear you?
你能大聲一點讓大家都聽見嗎？
Management wants staff to speak up about potential problems.
管理層希望員工能提出潛在的問題。

items.colloc: spread on the bread 塗在麵包上 | spread on a surface 塗抹在表面
items.distinct: apply 應用；塗抹 | smear 弄髒；塗抹
ex: The technician spread on a layer of protective coating.
技術人員塗抹了一層保護塗層。
You should spread on the adhesive evenly across the metal.
你應該將黏合劑均勻地塗在金屬表面上。
She spread on the paste to seal the leaking pipe.
她把漿糊塗上去以密封漏水的管線。

items.colloc: stand for quality 代表品質 | stand for values 代表價值觀
items.distinct: represent 代表 | tolerate 容忍
ex: Our company logo stands for innovation and excellence.
我們的公司標誌象徵創新與卓越。
What does the abbreviation in the report stand for?
報告中的縮寫代表什麼意思？
The manager will not stand for any unprofessional behavior.
經理絕不容忍任何不專業的行為。

items.colloc: stand in for a colleague 代替同事 | stand in for the manager 代替經理
items.distinct: replace 取代 | substitute for 替換
ex: The assistant will stand in for the director during the trip.
助理將在出差期間代理總監職務。
Can you stand in for me during the afternoon presentation?
你能在下午的簡報中代替我嗎？
She had to stand in for the lead speaker at the last minute.
她不得不在最後一刻頂替主講人。

items.pos: phr. 監督；站在旁邊監視
items.colloc: stand over an employee 監督員工 | stand over someone's shoulder 站在旁邊盯著
items.distinct: supervise 管理；監督 | oversee 視察；監管
ex: The supervisor had to stand over the trainees to ensure accuracy.
主管必須監督培訓生以確保精確度。
I dislike having my boss stand over me while I work.
我不喜歡工作時主管站在旁邊監視。
He stood over the project team until the deadline was met.
他一直在旁監督專案團隊直到期限達成。

items.colloc: stay awake all night 整晚保持清醒 | struggle to stay awake 努力保持清醒
items.distinct: remain alert 保持警覺 | be vigilant 保持警惕
ex: He drank coffee to stay awake during the long conference.
他喝了咖啡以在冗長的會議中保持清醒。
It is hard to stay awake after such a tiring day.
在疲憊的一天過後很難保持清醒。
The security guard must stay awake throughout the night shift.
保全人員在夜班期間必須保持清醒。

items.pos: phr. 敬請期待；繼續鎖定
items.colloc: stay tuned for updates 敬請期待後續更新 | stay tuned to the channel 鎖定此頻道
items.distinct: remain updated 保持更新 | watch for news 留意新聞
ex: Stay tuned for more details regarding the upcoming merger.
敬請期待關於即將到來合併案的更多細節。
We will announce the winner soon, so please stay tuned.
我們很快就會宣布得獎者，請繼續關注。
Stay tuned to our website for the latest market insights.
請鎖定我們的網站以獲取最新市場分析。

items.pos: phr. 攪拌進入；加入並攪拌
items.colloc: stir into the mixture 加入混合物中攪拌 | stir into a liquid 加入液體攪拌
items.distinct: mix with 與...混合 | blend into 融入
ex: Stir the seasoning into the sauce before serving.
上菜前將調味料拌入醬汁中。
Gently stir the additive into the chemical solution.
輕輕地將添加劑攪拌入化學溶液中。
Please stir the sugar into your coffee until it dissolves.
請將糖攪拌進咖啡裡直到溶解。

items.colloc: wait and stop at a light 等待紅綠燈 | stop at a light on the way 在路上遇紅燈停車
items.distinct: stop at a crosswalk 在斑馬線停車 | pull over 靠邊停車
ex: The taxi had to stop at a light on the way to the airport.
計程車在前往機場的路上必須在紅綠燈處停下。
We missed the turn because we had to stop at a light.
我們因為在紅綠燈處停車而錯過了轉彎。
I will pick you up after I stop at a light ahead.
我在前方紅綠燈處停好車後就會接你。

items.colloc: stop for fuel at a station 在加油站停車加油 | plan to stop for fuel 計畫停下加油
items.distinct: refuel 加油 | fill up 加滿
ex: We need to stop for fuel before heading to the client site.
我們前往客戶公司前需要先停下來加油。
The rental car requires us to stop for fuel before returning.
租車歸還前我們必須停下來加滿油。
They decided to stop for fuel at the nearest service station.
他們決定在最近的服務站停車加油。

items.colloc: check the street sign 確認路牌 | look for a street sign 尋找路牌
items.distinct: traffic sign 交通標誌 | billboard 看板
ex: The street sign was hidden behind the overgrown tree.
路牌被茂密的樹木遮住了。
He missed the street sign because of the heavy rain.
因為大雨他錯過了路牌。
Look for the blue street sign at the next intersection.
在下個路口尋找藍色的路牌。

items.colloc: clean the table cloth 清潔桌布 | place a table cloth 鋪上桌布
items.distinct: table mat 餐墊 | table cover 桌罩
ex: The restaurant uses a crisp white table cloth for dinner.
該餐廳晚餐時會使用潔白的桌布。
Please remove the stained table cloth before the guests arrive.
請在客人到達前撤下髒掉的桌布。
The catering staff spread a new table cloth on the banquet table.
外燴人員在宴會桌上鋪了一張新桌布。
